Regression Discontinuity Results

Override passage and Moody’s credit ratings

Design Summary

The RD design uses question-level override vote shares as the running variable. The cutoff is 50% approval, so the running variable is YesVotes / (YesVotes + NoVotes) - 0.50, and treatment is passage at or above the cutoff. The primary sample keeps the operating override question closest to the cutoff within each municipality-year. Moody’s ratings are measured at annual post-vote horizons from h = 1 through h = 5.

Fiscal Stress Heterogeneity

These exploratory heterogeneity checks split operating overrides by pre-vote fiscal stress. Low fiscal reserve is the headline split, and high debt is a parallel robustness split. The formal interaction test uses fixed-bandwidth local linear models; the estimate column is the difference between the stressed and non-stressed RD jump at the cutoff.
